source_note: Verified Physics Form Two scheme of work for Term II (TIE curriculum). 14 weeks: Nature and Reflection of Light (Weeks 1-4), Refraction and Dispersion of Light (Weeks 5-8), Optical Instruments (Weeks 9-14). 4 periods per week (two 80-min double periods).
